title: Evaluate a fixed universal shuffle equivalence on cochain diagrams
statement: In $\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta\times\Delta,\mathrm{Ab})$, let $P,Q$ be nonnegative chain complexes with specified term isomorphisms $p_n:P_n\simeq R_{(n,n)}$ and $q_n:Q_n\simeq\bigoplus_{a+b=n}R_{(a,b)}$ as in [lem-sfb-free-bisimplex-projective-resolutions]. Assume on every generator that the transported $P$ boundary is the diagonal alternating coface sum and the transported $Q$ boundary is the separate sum $\partial_1+(-1)^a\partial_2$, with terms from zero directions omitted. Let $e:Q\simeq_h P$ be a fixed homotopy equivalence whose forward map on each $(a,b)$ generator is the signed lattice-path sum of [lem-sfb-universal-shuffle-homotopy-inverse]. Then for any abelian category $\mathcal C$ there are homotopy equivalences $F_X:D(X)\simeq_h T(X)$ for all diagrams $X:\Delta\times\Delta\to\operatorname{Ch}^{\geq0}(\mathcal C)$, with the concrete totals of [def-sfb-bicosimplicial-shuffle-totalizations], such that on each $(n,n,r)$ inclusion their forward maps are exactly the sum over all $\mu\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of the specified shuffle summands. No exactness, projectivity, augmentation, or derived-category data is assumed or concluded here.

proof.text: Identify each ULift free representable with the singleton finite-list representable. Enumerate the finite antidiagonal a+b=n by a list of length n+1 and identify its sum with the corresponding finite-list object. Conjugate the given differentials, maps and homotopies along these isomorphisms to the induced full subcategory of finite representable sums. This uses explicit free-group maps on generators and finite biproduct inclusions and projections; it does not choose resolutions.

proof.text: Apply contravariant finite representable matrix totalization to the transported equivalence. Its biproduct and antidiagonal coproduct characterizations identify the evaluated P total with D and the evaluated Q total with T. The assumed generator boundary formulas give diagonal alternating cofaces for P and the separate signed cofaces for Q; the internal sign is (-1)^n. These identifications are chain isomorphisms and carry the evaluated homotopies to actual total homotopies.

proof.text: A lattice path from (0,0) to (a,b) is determined by the subset of its horizontal-step positions, whose complement gives its vertical positions. Its coordinates at vertex i count preceding positions, hence give the two alpha maps. A vertical step before a horizontal step is precisely an inversion (i,j) with i in mu, j in mu-complement, j<i. Reindex the fixed generator formula by these subsets; the matrix entry formula then gives the specified finite-subset sum on every coproduct inclusion. Transport the evaluated inverse and both homotopies along the chain isomorphisms.

theorem evaluate_universal_shuffle
    (P Q : ChainComplex (SimplexCategory × SimplexCategory ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ℕ)
    (p : ∀ n : ℕ, P.X n ≅ FreeBisimplex.representable.{0} (⦋n⦌, ⦋n⦌))
    (q : ∀ n : ℕ, Q.X n ≅ FreeBisimplex.totalTerm.{0} n)
    (hP : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : SimplexCategory × SimplexCategory)
      (α : (⦋n + 1⦌, ⦋n + 1⦌) ⟶ j),
      (p n).hom.app j ((P.d (n + 1) n).app j
        ((p (n + 1)).inv.app j (generator α))) =
      ∑ k : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k.val •
        generator ((SimplexCategory.δ k, SimplexCategory.δ k) ≫ α))
    (hQ : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (j : SimplexCategory × SimplexCategory)
      (α : (⦋a⦌, ⦋b⦌) ⟶ j),
      (q (a + b - 1)).hom.app j ((Q.d (a + b) (a + b - 1)).app j
        ((q (a + b)).inv.app j (totalGenerator a b (a + b) rfl j α))) =
      totalBoundary a b j α)
    (e : HomotopyEquiv Q P)
    (hσ : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (j : SimplexCategory × SimplexCategory)
      (α : (⦋a⦌, ⦋b⦌) ⟶ j),
      (p (a + b)).hom.app j ((e.hom.f (a + b)).app j
        ((q (a + b)).inv.app j (totalGenerator a b (a + b) rfl j α))) =
      shuffleGenerator a b j α) :
    ∃ F : ∀ X : SimplexCategory × SimplexCategory ⥤ CochainComplex C ℕ,
        HomotopyEquiv (diagonalTotal X) (successiveTotal X),
      ∀ (X : SimplexCategory × SimplexCategory ⥤ CochainComplex C ℕ)
        (n r m : ℕ) (h : n + r = m),
        diagonalInclusion X n r m h ≫ (F X).hom.f m =
          ∑ μ : Finset (Fin n), shuffleTerm X n r m h μ
